notes: Audit performed 2026-10-11 against official awarding-body/government domains only; all classifications rest on pages fetched on that date. dfat.gov.au (record 30) was unreachable via the plain HTTP fetcher and curl (timeouts) but was read via a headless browser; its logo URL could not be verified, so logo_or_image_url is null. koica.go.kr was unreachable (transport error); record 215 rests on the official Korean embassy notice at ge.mofa.go.kr. futurescholars.mohesr.gov.eg was unreachable (transport error); record 675 rests on the official State Information Service notice at sis.gov.eg. Non-official URLs present in some records' official_urls lists (anr.fr, bs.china-embassy.gov.cn and sutd.edu.sg on record 149; sutd.edu.sg on record 215; anr.fr on record 276) were not used because they are not the awarding body's domain for that programme. No record was classified genuinely_discontinued or uncertain: no official page showed withdrawal OR discontinuation, and every record had at least one readable official page. Records 618 and 675 were placed in temporarily_closed_awaiting_announcement because their only published dates (30 Aug 2026 and 4 Sep 2026) have passed with no next date announced, although neither page literally prints the word 'closed'; hence their lower confidence (0.6/0.65). Where a page states no monetary amount or no logo was verified from the awarding body's own domain, those fields are null. Next-round windows for recurring programmes (records 30, 149, 215, 276, 368, 415, 486, 715) are not yet published on official pages as of the check date, so next_deadline_or_window is null.
